# XHelpers Pro 1.0.10 (22)
- Refine Music & Playlists dialogs with clearer titles, consistent action buttons, and colors that distinguish information, warnings, and destructive actions. - Explain why YouTube Mix links cannot be imported and show how to use individual video links or a regular public playlist instead. - Improve playlist import validation, progress, cancellation, and recovery messages so problems have a clear next step. - Clarify account availability, local media repair, library recovery, and deletion confirmations while preserving saved playlists and local data. - Polish the shared player, audio effects, and related media dialogs. - Give installed Pro editions precedence over their free editions when launching apps in the same product family. - Translate the new interface text across all 25 supported translation languages and correct existing translations and ambiguous English labels.
Public YouTube playlist imports continue to use the publisher's service after a separate privacy disclosure. YouTube account connection, account playlists, and Liked Videos remain unavailable in this version. Saved account access can be removed locally; Google's authorization is managed in Google Account permissions. Xin account features remain disabled in this release.
YouTube's visible player, video availability and playback restrictions still apply. Protected or streaming Apple Music items continue to use MusicKit; per-player volume adjustment is unavailable for those items.
